baseline.statement: Both generations use the bytes acquired on October 4. The earlier logical generation excludes A2; it is not a September 16 source snapshot or a reconstruction of original runtime evidence.
baseline.type: reconstructed logical RFP plus A1 baseline

new.statement: Sealed proposals are due 2026-10-21 at 15:00 America/New_York; questions closed 2026-09-21 at 17:00.

old.statement: Sealed proposals are due 2026-10-21 at 15:00 America/New_York; questions closed 2026-09-21 at 17:00.

new.statement: The proposed solution must use only United States data centers and storage.

old.statement: The proposed solution must use only United States data centers and storage.

new.statement: The proposed software/integrator needs three comparable implementations within the preceding five years.

old.statement: The proposed software/integrator needs three comparable implementations within the preceding five years.

new.statement: Proposal validity is amended to 120 days after the due date.

old.statement: Proposal offers remain valid for 90 days after the due date.

new.statement: Provide one integrated solution with a primary implementor responsible for the complete scope; a standalone HCM proposal is unacceptable.

old.statement: Bidders must cover the entire Core scope and may combine their products with partner products.

new.statement: Laserfiche replacement and migration of its existing content are not expected; prospective use of offered document capabilities remains possible.

old.statement: The application table marks Laserfiche for replacement.

new.statement: PeopleSoft migration is described as three years across HR, Finance and Budget, totaling 500-600 GB; object-specific active/open and attachment rules still apply.

old.statement: Implementation includes data conversion and migration.

new.statement: Assume identified integrations at initial go-live; discuss any necessary phasing with the County.

old.statement: Implementation includes integration and interface development.

new.statement: Attachment A is the issued Excel workbook; its Questionnaire tab contains the technical and hosting requirements, with no separate form.

old.statement: The RFP references both DOCX and XLSX versions of Attachment A.

new.statement: Retain physical submission; USB must include the PDF proposal and completed native Excel attachments, while hard copy may summarize the workbooks.

old.statement: Submit an original physical proposal and an electronic PDF on USB; electronic delivery is not accepted.

new.statement: The 20-page cap applies to the Executive Summary; specified appendices and supporting documents are excluded and cannot replace required responses.

old.statement: The Executive Summary file is limited to 20 pages; Excel attachments and the sample plan are excluded.

new.statement: A publisher may identify implementation or software subcontractors under section 7.10; that proposal identification constitutes the stated prior approval.

old.statement: Subcontracting needs prior County approval and disclosure of services, entities, roles, resumes and references.

new.statement: The County will consider disclosed negotiated SaaS warranty and service remedies; an exception is neither automatically rejected nor automatically accepted.

old.statement: The warranty clause states that limitations and exceptions are unacceptable.

new.statement: Minimums: CGL $1M/$2M, auto $1M, workers/employers statutory, E&O $1M, cyber $1M/$2M; award-stage evidence remains required.

old.coordinate: RFP p23 section 7.8; p27 Attachment F
old.statement: An awardee supplies County-approved CGL, auto, workers/employers and cyber coverage; cyber minimums are $1M per event and $2M aggregate.

new.statement: Acknowledge Attachment F and disclose exceptions in the proposal without signing it at that stage.

old.coordinate: RFP p19 section 6.1; pp26-28 Attachment F
old.statement: The proposal addresses Attachment F, which the awarded proposer must sign.

new.statement: Round 3 is scored independently; Round 2 scores do not carry forward or combine.

old.statement: Finalists undergo further due diligence against the published criteria using information collected to that point.

new.statement: Award is anticipated in early 2027; the vendor recommends implementation timing and phasing.

old.statement: Award timing is to be announced.

new.statement: A teamed response may present publisher and implementation-partner experience with clear attribution of each entity's work and comparable context.
Migrate source documents within the history window: approximately 120,000 financial and 84,000 HR documents.
Use the existing accounting structure without redesign.
Price all required-area functions, including workforce scheduling; evaluation tags do not exclude Core requirements. Explain grouped modifications and their covered requirements.
The contract term is at least five years with equal-term renewal capability; annual uplift caps are requested.
The County requests the offered SLA and uptime commitment; the stated 99.99% is not a proposal-disqualifying pass/fail criterion.
Plante Moran is not permitted to bid.
The broad cloud-identity affirmative answer and the later SSO-negative answer require a documented scope reconciliation.
Reconcile API-inclusive offer pricing with County responsibility for third-party access and fees before assigning interface charges.
Map the go-live year plus two preceding years against the compound fiscal-year answer and object-specific history windows.

interpretation_boundaries.statement: The referenced minimum criterion is United States data-center/storage residency. This packet does not infer a separate blanket offshore-personnel ban or permission.
Laserfiche history is excluded while in-window PeopleSoft source documents are included; those are distinct repositories.
Optional or considered applications must be distinguished from required-area functions. The actual A-D workbooks still need source binding before a pricing response.
Total employees, annual W-2s and role-specific licenses describe different populations; do not sum them or convert them into a contract price here.
Negotiability does not accept a proposed exception, remove uncapped breach-remediation exposure, or waive any insurance term.

normalization.coverage: Only material implementation, qualification and response-boundary facts are modeled.
normalization.curable_false: No cure decision is asserted. This Boolean is required by the existing schema and does not create a County rejection rule or an internal qualification policy.
normalization.prior_decisions: Empty: no County/prime acceptance, qualifying reference approval or prior review decision is fabricated.
normalization.statement_hash: SHA-256 of each original UTF-8 statement without a trailing newline.

unresolved_source_scope.finding: The broad cloud-identity answer and the SSO answer in the timekeeping sequence point in different directions. Their application scope is not resolved by assuming one silently overrides the other.
unresolved_source_scope.owner_action: The existing security/pursuit owner must reconcile module scope and the referenced hosting evidence. No SSO exemption or certification is claimed.

unresolved_source_scope.finding: API-inclusive pricing and County responsibility for third-party access, licensing and development may distinguish ERP-side and third-party costs; that allocation is not fully specified.
unresolved_source_scope.owner_action: Bind responsibilities and charges per interface before any price or delivery commitment.

unresolved_source_scope.finding: The go-live-year-plus-two-years answer must be mapped against the compound fiscal-year answer and each open/active object rule.
unresolved_source_scope.owner_action: Use an explicit dated object inventory; do not invent a four-year universal window or a fixed conversion fee.

unresolved_source_scope.finding: Attribution of teamed experience is clarified; the question about whether installations must already be live is not separately answered.
unresolved_source_scope.owner_action: Preserve the three-implementation/five-year requirement and County assessment of comparability. The workstream has no new qualifying-install evidence.

unresolved_source_scope.finding: The yes answer to an either/or timing question does not identify one of its alternatives.
unresolved_source_scope.owner_action: Keep the date of retain-versus-replace decisions unspecified until it is actually established.
